qe: Deficiency of which vitamin causes scurvy, characterised by bleeding gums and delayed wound healing?
qh: किस विटामिन की कमी से स्कर्वी रोग होता है, जिसमें मसूड़ों से रक्त आना तथा घाव भरने में विलंब होता है?
e: Scurvy (skurvi) vitamin C yaani ascorbic acid ki kami se hota hai; isme masudon se khoon aata hai, daant hilne lagte hain, ghau der se bharte hain tatha thakan rahti hai. Vitamin C paani me ghulta hai (water-soluble) tatha amla, santra, nimbu, tamatar tatha hara saag jaise khane se milta hai; isliye naveen sabzi-fal ka istemal iske bachav ka bada upaay hai. Isi karan purane samay me samundari yatraon me yah rog aam hota tha, kyunki taja fal-sabzi lambi yatra me nahi milti thi. Vitamin A ki kami se raat me kam dikhai dena (night blindness) tatha aankh ki samasya hoti hai; vitamin D ki kami se bacchon me sukha rog (rickets) tatha bado me haddi kamzor hoti hai; vitamin K ki kami se khoon jamne (blood clotting) me badha aati hai. Isliye teeno doosre vikalp alag-alag rog se jude hain, is prashn ke lakshan se nahi. Exam point: vitamin C ki kami = skurvi (scurvy); vitamin A = raat ki andhata; vitamin D = rickets; vitamin K = khoon jamne me samasya.

qe: Which of the following vitamins is necessary for the normal clotting of blood?
qh: रक्त के सामान्य थक्का जमने (clotting) के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विटामिन आवश्यक है?
e: Khoon ka jamna (clotting) kai prakriyaon se hota hai aur usme prothrombin tatha anya clotting factor ka bada haath hota hai. Vitamin K (jise 'K' isliye kehte hain kyunki Danish me 'Koagulation' ka arth jamna hai) liver me in clotting factors ke nirman ke liye anivarya hai; isliye vitamin K ki kami se khoon der tak bahsakta hai, chhote-chhote ghau se bhi khoon rukta nahi tatha bleeding disorders badh jaate hain. Nayajanm shishu ko aksar vitamin K ka injection isi karan diya jaata hai. Vitamin B12 ki kami se khuun ki kami tatha nason ki samasya (pernicious anaemia) hoti hai; vitamin C ki kami se skurvi, aur vitamin E ek anti-oxidant hai jo koshikaon ki raksha karta hai tatha iski kami se kuchh logon me nason ki kamzori se jude lakshan maane jaate hain - lekin inme se koi bhi khoon jamne ki mukhya prakriya se seedha juda nahi hai. Kale patte wali sabzi tatha kuchh anaj vitamin K ke achhe srot hain. Exam point: vitamin K = khoon jamna (clotting), isliye 'K' for Koagulation; vitamin B12 = anaemia, vitamin C = skurvi.

qe: Which fat-soluble vitamins are together known as the 'ADK' group along with E, and why is this group called fat-soluble?
qh: वसा में घुलनशील विटामिन E के साथ कौन से विटामिन मिलकर 'ADK' समूह बनाते हैं, और इस समूह को वसा-घुलनशील क्यों कहा जाता है?
oe: Vitamins A, D and K; they dissolve in body fats and are stored in the liver and fatty tissues
Vitamins B1, B6 and B12; they dissolve in water and are stored in muscles
Vitamins A, B and C; they are destroyed on cooking
Vitamins C, D and K; they are found only in fruits
oh: विटामिन A, D तथा K; ये शरीर की वसा में घुलकर यकृत तथा वसीय ऊतकों में संचित रहते हैं
विटामिन B1, B6 तथा B12; ये जल में घुलकर मांसपेशियों में संचित रहते हैं
विटामिन A, B तथा C; ये पकाने पर नष्ट हो जाते हैं
विटामिन C, D तथा K; ये केवल फलों में पाए जाते हैं
e: Vitamins ko unke ghulansheelata ke aadhaar par do vargon me baanta jaata hai. Pehla varga - vasa-ghulansheel (fat-soluble) vitamins: A, D, E tatha K; inhe 'ADK' ya ADEK samuh bhi kehte hain. Ye vitamins bhojan ki vasaa ke saath avshoshan (absorb) hote hain, sharer ki vasaa me ghulte hain tatha ykrit (liver) tatha vasa-utakon me sanchit reh sakte hain; isliye inki zyada matra bhi nuksaan pahuncha sakti hai. Doosra varga - jala-ghulansheel (water-soluble) vitamins: B-complex tatha C; ye paani me ghulte hain, sharer me sanchay nahi karte aur atirikt matra peshab ke saath nikal jaati hai, isliye inhe bhojan me regular lena padta hai. Vitamin A raat ki drishti, D haddi tatha daant, E anti-oxidant, aur K khoon jamne se juda hai. Isliye 'B1, B6, B12' ya 'A, B, C' ya 'C, D, K' wali jodiyaan ADK samuh nahi banati; woh galat hain. Exam point: vasa-ghulansheel vitamins = A, D, E, K (sanchay hota hai); jala-ghulansheel = B-complex tatha C (sanchay nahi hota, roz lena padta hai).

qe: Deficiency of iron in the human diet mainly causes:
qh: मानव आहार में लोहे (iron) की कमी से मुख्यतः कौन-सा रोग होता है?
e: Loha (iron) hamoglobin ke nirman ke liye zaroori hai, aur haemoglobin hi rakt me oxygen ko poore shareer tak pahunchata hai. Jab khane me loha kam ho jaata hai, to haemoglobin ki matra ghat jaati hai aur 'rakt-alpta' ya anaemia ho jaati hai; isme thakan, kamzori, peela rang tatha saans phoolna jaise lakshan dikhte hain. Isi karan sarkar ki anaemia mukta bharat jaise karyakram chale hain, jisme loha-goli tatha loha-yukt khane par jor diya jaata hai. Galgand (goitre) iodine ki kami se hota hai; sookha rog (rickets) vitamin D ki kami se bacchon me haddiyon ke vikas ki samasya hai; beri-beri vitamin B1 (thiamine) ki kami se hota hai. Isliye teeno baaki vikalp anya poshak tatvaon ki kami se jude hain, loha se nahi. Loha ke achhe srot hara saag (palak), gud, khajur, dal tatha kale chana hain. Exam point: loha ki kami = anaemia (rakt-alpta); iodine = galgand; vitamin D = rickets; vitamin B1 = beri-beri.

qe: Kwashiorkor, a protein deficiency disease seen in children, is characterised by:
qh: बच्चों में दिखने वाला प्रोटीन की कमी से होने वाला रोग क्वाशियोरकोर किस लक्षण से पहचाना जाता है?
oe: Stunted growth with swelling of the body (oedema) and a protruding belly, with the face appearing puffy
Only night blindness with dry eyes
Enlargement of the thyroid gland in the neck
oh: शरीर में सूजन (शोफ) तथा उभरी हुई पेट के साथ वृद्धि-रुकावट, चेहरा फूला हुआ दिखता है
केवल रतौंधी तथा आँखों का सूखापन
मसूड़ों से रक्त आना तथा दाँत हिलना
गर्दन में थायरॉइड ग्रंथि का बढ़ जाना
e: Kwasiorkor protein (prateen) ki ghor kami se hone wala rog hai jo aksar 1 se 5 saal ke bacchon me dikhta hai. Isme peet (belly) phool kar ubhri hui dikhti hai, payr tatha chehra sooj jaata hai (oedema), twacha tatha baal rukhe ho jaate hain, wazan badhta nahi aur bachcha sust tatha chidchida rahta hai; iska naam Ghana ke ek shabd se aaya hai jiska arth 'wchhuda hua bachcha' hota hai. Iska nikat ka rog marasmus hai, jo protein tatha calorie dono ki kami se hota hai aur isme bachcha bahut hi dubla ho jaata hai (sujan nahi hoti). Ratondhi (night blindness) vitamin A ki kami ka lakshan hai, masudon se khoon aana vitamin C ki kami ka (skurvi), aur gale me thyroid granthi ka banna iodine ki kami ka (galgand) hai. Isliye baaki teeno vikalp anya kamiyon se jude lakshan hain, kwashiyorkor ke sahi lakshan nahi. Exam point: kwashiyorkor = protein ki kami, sujan tatha ubhri hui pet; marasmus = protein aur calorie dono ki kami, chhota dubla shareer; iodine = galgand.

qe: Which of the following pairs of vitamin and its main dietary source is correctly matched?
qh: विटामिन तथा उसके मुख्य आहार-स्रोत का निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित है?
oe: Vitamin D - sunlight acting on skin and fatty fish
oh: विटामिन D - त्वचा पर सूर्य का प्रकाश तथा वसायुक्त मछली
विटामिन B12 - पॉलिश किया हुआ चावल
e: Vitamin D ki khaas baat hai ki woh khane ke saath-saath sooraj ki roshni se bhi banta hai: sooraj ki kalash-purvi (ultraviolet) kirane twacha (skin) me maujood ek padarth ko vitamin D me badal deti hain - isliye ise 'sabri vitamin' bhi kehte hain; vasaayukt machhli, ande ki jrdi tatha doodh ke utpad bhi iske srot hain. Vitamin A ke achhe srot kale-bhare rang wali sabzi tatha doodh, makhan, ghee tatha jigar hain - khataayphal me keval vitamin C hota hai, isliye pehli jodi galat hai. Vitamin C khatte fal, amla, nimbu, santra tatha hara saag me milta hai; doodh-makhan me woh bahut kam hota hai. Vitamin B12 mansa, machhli, ande tatha doodh jaisi pashu-jaat khane me milta hai; polis ya chawal se bhaap me woh nikal jaata hai, balki polis chawal me vitamin B1 ki kami se beri-beri ka khatra hota hai. Isliye sirf doosri jodi sahi hai. Exam point: vitamin D = dhoop (sunlight) plus vasaayukt machhli; vitamin A = hara-peela fal-sabzi tatha doodh-makhan; vitamin C = khatte fal; vitamin B12 = pashu-jaat aahaar.
